title: Learn Backend with C#
tagline: ASP.NET Core APIs from first controller to production services
description: A three-level curriculum for building backend services with C# and ASP.NET Core — from HTTP and SQL through authenticated APIs to systems you can test, cache, observe, and ship.
prerequisites: Comfort using a terminal or Visual Studio / VS Code, plus Git
Willingness to install the .NET SDK and a local PostgreSQL (or SQL Server) instance

levels.title: HTTP, SQL & First APIs
levels.goal: Stand up a small HTTP API that reads and writes real data

topics.title: How the web talks
items: HTTP methods, status codes, and headers
REST principles: resources, URLs, and idempotency

topics.title: SQL & relational design
items: Tables, primary keys, and foreign keys
SELECT, JOIN, WHERE, and GROUP BY
Indexes you actually need on day one

topics.title: ASP.NET Core basics
items: Minimal APIs or controllers and routing

topics.title: Git & API clients
items: Branch, commit, and PR habits for backend teams
Docker Compose for a local database

projects: CRUD API for members or products with EF Core
Docker Compose so a teammate can run the API locally

levels.title: Authenticated, Tested Services
levels.goal: Ship APIs with auth, validation, migrations, and tests you trust

topics.title: Authentication
items: ASP.NET Identity or JWT bearer auth

topics.title: xUnit and WebApplicationFactory
items: Integration tests against the real pipeline

topics.title: API contracts
items: OpenAPI / Swagger as the source of truth
Seed data that matches production shapes

projects: REST API with JWT auth, roles, and xUnit coverage
Migration-backed schema for a real feature
Rate-limited public endpoint with ProblemDetails errors

levels.title: Production-Grade Backend Systems
levels.goal: Design services that stay correct under load, retries, and money-moving traffic

topics.title: Service boundaries
items: MediatR or similar for in-process commands
Outbox pattern for reliable side effects

topics.title: Queues and workers
items: MassTransit, Azure Service Bus, or SQS
Retries, dead-letter queues, and poison messages

topics.title: API security
items: Injection, mass assignment, and secrets in config
Rate limiting, CORS, and webhook signature verification

topics.title: Ledger-style consistency
items: Immutable ledger rows vs. mutable balances
Reconciliation when callbacks are late or duplicated

topics.title: Logs, metrics, traces
items: Correlation IDs across requests and jobs

topics.title: Containers and config
items: CI with tests, migrations, and published OpenAPI

projects: SACCO member and savings API with role-based access
Containerized ASP.NET Core service with CI and Swagger
